testing_policy.policy: Minimum representative coverage; expand only on failures or materially different changed behavior.
testing_policy.sampling: Start with one affected village per mod rather than repeating equivalent variants.
testing_policy.shared_conditions: Test shared weather and day/night behavior at one suitable representative fixture; a second successful fixture is sufficient corroboration when warranted, not a reason to repeat every variant.
testing_policy.stop_rule: Stop after the scoped representative checks pass; use manual assistance for slow or unreliable automation.
testing_policy.evidence_rule: Shared-rule confidence is indirect coverage, not a claim that every untested variant passed.
